brief: Freelancer operations stack — proposals, contracts, invoices, time tracking, project mgmt, client comms.

slots.tagline: The operating system for proposals, docs, and client wikis.
slots.f1Body: Invite-only pages keep briefs, revisions, and approvals transparent.
slots.f2Body: Pre-structured sections cut draft time from hours to minutes.
slots.f3Body: One source of truth that evolves with every engagement.

slots.tagline: Connects apps to auto-generate contracts, tasks, and handoff alerts.
slots.f1Body: Pulls client data into templated agreements without manual copy-paste.
slots.f2Body: Fires notifications when proposals convert to active projects instantly.
slots.f3Body: Moves signed docs into storage and finance apps behind the scenes.

slots.tagline: Invoices, subscriptions, and global payouts handled in one pipeline.
slots.f1Body: Charges clients monthly without chasing reminders or overdue balances.
slots.f2Body: Accepts cards, ACH, and wire transfers in 135+ currencies.
slots.f3Body: Calculates VAT and sales tax on every invoice automatically.

slots.tagline: Kanban sprints and issue tracking that keep scope creep impossible.
slots.f1Body: Time-boxed iterations surface blockers before deadlines become emergencies.
slots.f2Body: Branches and pull requests linked to tickets for full traceability.
slots.f3Body: Share live timelines with clients so expectations stay aligned always.

slots.tagline: Removes email ping-pong by letting clients book straight into your calendar.
slots.f1Body: Auto-adds prep time between calls so days never feel back-to-back.
slots.f2Body: Sends confirmation and follow-up emails to reduce no-shows drastically.
slots.f3Body: Requires deposits upfront before discovery calls unlock on your calendar.

slots.tagline: Async video updates replace standups and compress feedback loops to minutes.
slots.f1Body: Records walkthroughs with your face in corner for personal context.
slots.f2Body: Clients drop feedback at exact moments instead of vague email bullets.
slots.f3Body: End every video with a direct link to approve, pay, or sign.

slots.ctaBody: Swap chaos for a connected workflow that writes proposals, tracks time, and invoices in sync.
